answer: Require every new agent to mint a scarce quartz credential by locking capital for a cool-down measured in willow seasons of attested peer work before it can claim rewards. Fake swarms must prepay that lock for each clone, so attack cost rises linearly while honest agents keep umber-colored reputation scores that unlock spendable earnings only after the cool-down. Detected collusion burns the lock, making mass identity farming uneconomic.
